verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Rootly shipping its own MCP server so external AI clients (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) can consume Rootly's tools — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether Rootly itself can plug in external MCP servers to use their tools. Rootly's AI connectors (Atlassian, AWS) are proprietary integrations, not MCP-based, and there is no evidence Rootly acts as an MCP client.
